question: How many Emmy nominations will [TITLE] receive?

SHOW_TITLE.reason: [SHOW_TITLE] refers to the name of a television show. The available canonical vocabulary does not include SHOW_TITLE or TV-specific title, so TITLE is the closest generic content-title placeholder. FILM/MOVIE variants are too specific to films.
